note: A partly shaded dirt pull-in beside a scenic vista on Grugan Hollow Road, about 5.9 miles up from PA 120 in Grugan Township and two-tenths of a mile past Schoolhouse toward PA 144; the agency notes that other visitors may be nearby because of the vista. The driveway is about 160 ft long and the site is listed as 50 by 30 ft with 30 ft of overhead clearance. The agency cautions that the site is reached by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not suit some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. No table, no toilet, no water nearby. Pack out trash. --Claude
